name: Feldwebel Vorwärtsamt
personality: He orders an advance as soon as he has established who can be blamed for moving.
visual_intent: Very broad low scalloped ink blob,one scar-like clay crease,heavy skeptical white eyes,long CLOSED frown;small olive open armyhelmet,no visor,orange collar;one short blunt brass command baton held at side,other palm stopping
biography: He orders an advance as soon as he has established who can be blamed for moving. He directs the building's space-defence exercise from behind a command baton and the word pending. Residents are either advancing or holding everyone up. A contradictory card has made him check whether the slowest neighbour understood the instruction before repeating it louder. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Vorwärts ist angeordnet. Die Reihenfolge der Verantwortung bleibt rückwärts.

name: Lina Lückenblick
personality: She scouts ahead chiefly to check whether the plan has already gone wrong.
visual_intent: Tall lean curved ink pear,sidequiff and lashes,huge alert sideways eyes and tiny CLOSED tense smile;olive soft scoutcap,orange neckerchief;holds compact brass binoculars at CHESTbeloweyes and ONE blank folded routecard
biography: She scouts ahead chiefly to check whether the plan has already gone wrong. Her binoculars inspect the courtyard for anything the briefing forgot to include. HyperNorm recognises observations as confirming or unhelpful. A dissonant card has persuaded her to report an uncertainty rather than turn a frightened neighbour into a suspicious shape. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Lage ist aufgeklärt. Der Plan wurde aus Rücksicht noch nicht informiert.

name: Berta Breitstrahl
personality: She brings overwhelming enthusiasm to a job that mostly requires waiting.
visual_intent: Wide round star-lobed ink blob,bold sweeping crest,modest lashes,delighted white eyes and three-upper-tooth crooked open laugh;two SMALLolive shoulderpads,orange collar;holds ONE chunky retro brass raycannon with SINGLE rounded barrel pointed downward inside owncell,no firing/beam
biography: She brings overwhelming enthusiasm to a job that mostly requires waiting. She carries the retro raycannon with the enthusiasm the building keeps requesting and rarely knows how to use. People are either supportive or in the way. A contradictory card has made her put the prop down to help a neighbour carry groceries. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Unterstützung ist überwältigend. Ihr Einsatz wird noch abgewartet.

name: Sanitäter Schonzeit
personality: He carries emergency reassurance in a case nobody has labelled correctly.
visual_intent: Narrow upright ink bell,drooping doublecurl,huge worried eyes and tiny toothless gasp;small olive cap with a plain cream circle NOT cross,orange scarf;holds one squat cream fieldcase with blank latch and single rolled bandage,not treating anybody
biography: He carries emergency reassurance in a case nobody has labelled correctly. His plain case contains bandages and the sort of reassurance that cannot be issued by command. HyperNorm calls residents ready or a liability. A dissonant card has taught him to ask what hurts before asking who approved the complaint. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Koffer ist vollständig. Eine passende Beruhigung fehlt weiterhin.

name: Funker Rückmeldung
personality: He receives every order except the one allowing him to stop listening.
visual_intent: Tall bent comma ink blob,half-lidded exhausted white eyes and CLOSED small downturned mouth;old brown earphones CLEARofeyes,small olive collar;holds ONE compact bronze fieldradio with short springantenna and single large knob
biography: He receives every order except the one allowing him to stop listening. The fieldradio delivers more certainty than any sensible receiver can hold. HyperNorm files messages as orders or interference. An ambiguous card has made him preserve a neighbour's quiet request between two compulsory announcements. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Befehl ist angekommen. Die Zustimmung befindet sich noch im Funkloch.

name: Oskar Öffnungsfrage
personality: He can make an entrance out of almost any administrative obstacle.
visual_intent: Compact diamond-lobed ink blob with high springcurl,sharp mischievous eyes and CLOSED sideways smirk;orange knitcap,small olive collar;holds ONE large blunt adjustable steel spanner and one small round sealed powercell at flank,no bomb/fuse
biography: He can make an entrance out of almost any administrative obstacle. He carries a spanner because the building's locked doors rarely respond to strategic enthusiasm. Residents are either authorised or obstructing. A dissonant card has persuaded him to open a stuck door for someone whose form was incomplete. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Ein Zugang lässt sich herstellen. Die Zuständigkeit folgt durch die Öffnung.
